passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David often prayed to God.
David wrote many psalms.

passages.text: O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks to the LORD.
David asks the LORD to hear his prayer.
David asks the LORD to listen to his plea.
David trusts the LORD’s faithfulness.
David asks the LORD to answer him because the LORD is righteous.
passages.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה׀ שְׁמַ֬ע תְּפִלָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה אֶל־ תַּחֲנוּנַ֑י בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ֥ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David is the LORD’s servant.
David asks the LORD not to judge him.
David says no one living is righteous before the LORD.
passages.original: וְאַל־ תָּב֣וֹא בְ֭מִשְׁפָּט אֶת־ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ יִצְדַּ֖ק לְפָנֶ֣יךָ כָל־ חָֽי׃

passages.text: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David says an enemy pursues his soul.
The enemy crushes David’s life to the ground.
The enemy makes David live in darkness.
David lives like people who died long ago.
passages.original: כִּ֥י רָ֘דַ֤ף אוֹיֵ֨ב׀ נַפְשִׁ֗י דִּכָּ֣א לָ֭אָרֶץ חַיָּתִ֑י הוֹשִׁיבַ֥נִי בְ֝מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים כְּמֵתֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David is God's servant.
David feels deep distress.
David says, "My spirit grows weak inside me."
David says, "My heart is troubled within me."
passages.original: וַתִּתְעַטֵּ֣ף עָלַ֣י רוּחִ֑י בְּ֝תוֹכִ֗י יִשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם לִבִּֽי׃

passages.text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist is in distress.
The psalmist remembers the days of old.
The psalmist thinks about all of God's works.
The psalmist reflects on what God has done.
The psalmist considers the work of God's hands.
passages.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי יָמִ֨ים׀ מִקֶּ֗דֶם הָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל־ פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵֽחַ׃

passages.text: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist feels weak and desperate.
The psalmist stretches out his hands to God.
He longs for God.
His soul thirsts for God.
His soul is like dry, parched land.
He asks God to answer him quickly.
He calls God by name, LORD.
His spirit is failing.
He pleads with God not to hide His face.
He fears becoming like those who go down to the grave.
passages.original: פֵּרַ֣שְׂתִּי יָדַ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ נַפְשִׁ֓י׀ כְּאֶֽרֶץ־ עֲיֵפָ֖ה לְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃ מַ֘הֵ֤ר עֲנֵ֨נִי׀ יְהוָה֮ כָּלְתָ֪ה ר֫וּחִ֥י אַל־ תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־ יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to the LORD.
The psalmist asks God to let him hear God's loving devotion in the morning.
The psalmist trusts in God.
The psalmist asks God to teach him the way he should walk.
The psalmist lifts up his soul to God.
passages.original: הַשְׁמִ֘יעֵ֤נִי בַבֹּ֨קֶר׀ חַסְדֶּךָ֮ כִּֽי־ בְךָ֪ בָ֫טָ֥חְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵ֗נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ־ ז֥וּ אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ אֵ֝לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֥אתִי נַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, you are my God.
I have enemies.
My enemies threaten me.
Deliver me from my enemies.
I come to you for safety.
I seek refuge in you.

passages.text: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David calls God his God.
David asks God to teach him.
David wants to do God’s will.
David says God’s Spirit is good.
David asks God’s good Spirit to lead him.
David wants to walk on level ground.
passages.original: לַמְּדֵ֤נִי׀ לַֽעֲשׂ֣וֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ֮ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֪ה אֱל֫וֹהָ֥י רוּחֲךָ֥ טוֹבָ֑ה תַּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִישֽׁוֹר׃

passages.text: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David calls the LORD by name.
David asks the LORD to revive him.
David says, "Do this for the sake of Your name."
David asks the LORD to bring his soul out of trouble.
David says, "Do this in Your righteousness."
passages.original: לְמַֽעַן־ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓׀ תוֹצִ֖יא מִצָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
passages.sermon:
God shows loving devotion.
God can cut off my enemies.
God can destroy all who afflict me.
I am God's servant.
passages.original: וּֽבְחַסְדְּךָ֮ תַּצְמִ֪ית אֹ֫יְבָ֥י וְֽ֭הַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל־ צֹרֲרֵ֣י נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּ֝֗י אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
